component.name: LaunchOverlay
component.script:
sub init() th = LumenTheme() m.th = th m.top.visible = false
m.scrim = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") m.scrim.width = 1920 m.scrim.height = 1080
card = m.top.createChild("Group") card.translation = [640, 330] m.card = card sheet = card.createChild("Poster") sheet.uri = "pkg:/images/ui/sheet_r44.9.png" sheet.blendColor = th.paper sheet.width = 640 sheet.height = 420
' App icon in its painted frame at 1.25x (360x240), centred. m.tileGroup = card.createChild("Group") m.tileGroup.translation = [140, 44] m.logoCard = m.tileGroup.createChild("Poster") m.logoCard.width = 360 m.logoCard.height = 240 m.icon = m.tileGroup.createChild("Poster") m.icon.width = 360 m.icon.height = 240 m.icon.loadDisplayMode = "scaleToFit" m.frame = m.tileGroup.createChild("Poster") m.frame.width = 360 m.frame.height = 240
m.title = card.createChild("Label") m.title.font = LumenFont("Fraunces-Title", 40) m.title.color = th.ink m.title.horizAlign = "center" m.title.width = 600 m.title.translation = [20, 300]
' Shimmer track (13.1). m.track = card.createChild("Group") m.track.translation = [120, 372] m.track.clippingRect = [0, 0, 400, 8] bar = m.track.createChild("Rectangle") bar.width = 400 bar.height = 8 bar.color = th.ink m.shine = m.track.createChild("Rectangle") m.shine.id = "shine" m.shine.width = 120 m.shine.height = 8 m.shine.color = th.yellow m.shimmer = m.top.createChild("Animation") m.shimmer.duration = 1.2 m.shimmer.repeat = true m.shimmer.easeFunction = "inOutCubic" si = m.shimmer.createChild("Vector2DFieldInterpolator") si.fieldToInterp = "shine.translation" si.key = [0, 1] si.keyValue = [[-120, 0], [400, 0]]
' Error variant (13.2). m.reason = card.createChild("Label") m.reason.font = LumenFont("Manrope-SemiBold", 22) m.reason.color = th.ink60 m.reason.horizAlign = "center" m.reason.wrap = true m.reason.maxLines = 2 m.reason.width = 560 m.reason.translation = [40, 350]
m.btnRetry = makeButton("Try again") m.btnDismiss = makeButton("Dismiss") end sub
function makeButton(text as string) as object g = m.card.createChild("Group") fill = g.createChild("Poster") fill.uri = "pkg:/images/ui/pill_64.9.png" fill.width = 200 fill.height = 64 ring = g.createChild("Poster") ring.uri = "pkg:/images/ui/pill_64_stroke.9.png" ring.width = 200 ring.height = 64 lbl = g.createChild("Label") lbl.font = LumenFont("Manrope-ExtraBold", 24) lbl.text = text lbl.width = 200 lbl.height = 64 lbl.horizAlign = "center" lbl.vertAlign = "center" return { group: g, fill: fill, ring: ring, label: lbl } end function
sub onApp() a = m.top.app if a = invalid then return m.logoCard.uri = "pkg:/images/tiles/card_" + PastelFor(a.id) + ".png" m.frame.visible = false m.icon.uri = m.top.iconBase + "/query/icon/" + a.id end sub
sub onDeep() m.scrim.color = WithAlpha(m.top.deep, 0.55) end sub
sub onState() s = m.top.state m.top.visible = (s <> "hidden") name = "" if m.top.app <> invalid then name = m.top.app.name launching = (s = "launching") m.track.visible = launching m.reason.visible = not launching m.btnRetry.group.visible = not launching m.btnDismiss.group.visible = not launching if launching m.title.text = "Opening " + name + "…" m.shimmer.control = "start" else m.shimmer.control = "stop" end if if s = "error" ' The card grows to fit the reason and buttons. m.title.text = "Couldn't open " + name m.reason.text = m.top.reason m.card.translation = [640, 280] m.btnRetry.group.translation = [100, 430] m.btnDismiss.group.translation = [340, 430] m.card.getChild(0).height = 530 m.top.buttonIndex = 0 paintButtons() else m.card.translation = [640, 330] m.card.getChild(0).height = 420 end if end sub
sub paintButtons() if m.btnRetry = invalid then return i = m.top.buttonIndex ' Primary: ink with yellow text. Outline: ink ring. Focused button: yellow fill. paintButton(m.btnRetry, i = 0, true) paintButton(m.btnDismiss, i = 1, false) end sub
sub paintButton(b as object, focused as boolean, primary as boolean) if focused b.fill.visible = true b.fill.blendColor = m.th.yellow b.ring.visible = true b.ring.blendColor = m.th.ink b.label.color = m.th.ink else if primary b.fill.visible = true b.fill.blendColor = m.th.ink b.ring.visible = false b.label.color = m.th.yellow else b.fill.visible = false b.ring.visible = true b.ring.blendColor = m.th.ink b.label.color = m.th.ink end if end sub
